pages.text:
今天是六一儿童节！一大早，咘咘就从床上蹦了起来，开心得两只耳朵都竖得高高的。
NOMI 帮她系好粉色蝴蝶结：「今天幼儿园有特别的活动哦！」
咘咘拍着小手：「六一快乐！咘咘要去幼儿园啦！」
pages.text_en:
Today is Children's Day! Bubu bounced out of bed early, her two ears standing tall with excitement.
NOMI helped tie her pink bow: "There are special activities at kindergarten today!"
Bubu clapped her little paws: "Happy Children's Day! Bubu is going to kindergarten!"

pages.text:
幼儿园门口好热闹！艳艳老师戴着大大的恐龙头套，站在门口挥手欢迎每一个小朋友。
「欢迎欢迎！吼——我是恐龙老师！」
咘咘笑得前仰后合：「艳艳老师变成恐龙啦！好好玩！」
pages.text_en:
The kindergarten entrance was so lively! Teacher Yanyan wore a big dinosaur headpiece, standing at the gate and waving to welcome every little friend.
"Welcome welcome! Roar — I'm Dinosaur Teacher!"
Bubu laughed so hard she nearly fell over: "Teacher Yanyan turned into a dinosaur! So fun!"

pages.text:
菲菲也来了！她穿着漂亮的夏天小裙子，跑过来拉住咘咘的手。
「咘咘！六一快乐！」
「菲菲！六一快乐！」
两个好朋友手拉手走进了幼儿园，NONO 在她们头顶飞来飞去：「叽叽！快进去看看！」
pages.text_en:
Feifei arrived too! She wore a pretty summer dress and ran over to hold Bubu's hand.
"Bubu! Happy Children's Day!"
"Feifei! Happy Children's Day!"
The two best friends walked into kindergarten hand in hand, while NONO flew around above them: "Chirp! Let's go see what's inside!"

pages.text:
教室里变成了小剧场！艳艳老师拉上了彩色的大幕布，灯光暗了下来。
「小朋友们坐好——木偶剧要开始啦！」
咘咘和菲菲紧挨着坐在最前排，眼睛瞪得大大的。
pages.text_en:
The classroom had been transformed into a little theater! Teacher Yanyan pulled the colorful curtain, and the lights dimmed.
"Everyone sit down — the puppet show is about to begin!"
Bubu and Feifei sat right next to each other in the front row, eyes wide open.

pages.text:
木偶剧太精彩了！一只大怪兽张开大嘴，一口吃掉了小熊猫！
小朋友们又害怕又紧张。咘咘抱着NOMI的胳膊，睁大眼睛盯着舞台。
pages.text_en:
The puppet show was amazing! A big scary monster opened its huge mouth and gobbled up the little panda!
All the children were scared and nervous. Bubu hugged NOMIs arm, staring at the stage with wide eyes.

pages.text:
就在这时，熊猫爸爸冲上来了！他勇敢地把大怪兽赶跑了！
"太棒了！"小朋友们使劲鼓掌。NONO激动地在空中转了三个圈。咘咘开心地拍着小手说："熊猫爸爸好厉害！"
pages.text_en:
Just then, Panda Dad rushed in! He bravely chased the big monster away!
"Hooray!" All the children clapped as hard as they could. NONO spun three excited loops in the air. Bubu clapped her little hands: "Panda Dad is so brave!"

pages.text:
看完木偶剧，艳艳老师带着大家来到走廊。哇！走廊上摆了好长好长一排小桌子和小椅子，一直延伸到走廊尽头。
「今天我们要坐火车吃早餐！」艳艳老师笑着说。
「火车？！」小朋友们都好惊喜。
pages.text_en:
After the puppet show, Teacher Yanyan led everyone to the hallway. Wow! A long, long row of little tables and chairs stretched all the way to the end of the hallway.
"Today we're riding the train for breakfast!" Teacher Yanyan said with a smile.
"A train?!" All the children were so surprised.

pages.text:
小朋友们排成长长一排坐下来，就像一列长长的火车！咘咘坐在菲菲旁边，小熊同学坐在对面，小狗同学坐在后面。
桌上有面包、牛奶、水果，大家一边吃一边叽叽喳喳说个不停。
NOMI 拿出小相机：「咔嚓！长长的火车饭！太可爱了！」
pages.text_en:
The children sat in a long, long row, just like a train! Bubu sat next to Feifei, Bear classmate sat across, and Corgi classmate sat behind.
Bread, milk, and fruit filled the tables. Everyone chattered happily while eating.
NOMI pulled out a little camera: "Click! The train breakfast! So cute!"

pages.text:
「呜——呜——长长的火车开啦！」咘咘举着面包当方向盘，假装在开火车。
菲菲也跟着喊：「呜——下一站到啦！」
整条走廊都是小朋友的笑声，艳艳老师在旁边拍了好多好多照片。
pages.text_en:
"Choo choo — the long train is moving!" Bubu held her bread like a steering wheel, pretending to drive the train.
Feifei joined in: "Choo — next station!"
The entire hallway was filled with laughter. Teacher Yanyan took photo after photo beside them.

pages.text:
吃完火车饭，艳艳老师神秘地笑了笑：「小朋友们，六一节还有礼物哦！」
她从大箱子里拿出一个个彩色的礼物袋，递给每个小朋友。
咘咘接过礼物袋，迫不及待地打开：「哇！是什么呀？」
pages.text_en:
After the train breakfast, Teacher Yanyan smiled mysteriously: "Children, there are gifts for Children's Day too!"
She took out colorful gift bags from a big box and handed one to each child.
Bubu grabbed her gift bag and couldn't wait to open it: "Wow! What is it?"

pages.text:
礼物袋里有一个小手摇风扇和一个迷你小游戏机！咘咘摇着风扇，凉飕飕的风吹在脸上。
菲菲在旁边按游戏机：「哔哔哔！好好玩！」
「我们交换着玩！」咘咘把风扇递给菲菲，菲菲把游戏机递给咘咘。好朋友就是要一起分享！
pages.text_en:
Inside the gift bag were a hand-crank fan and a mini game console! Bubu cranked the fan, cool breeze blowing on her face.
Feifei pressed buttons on the game console nearby: "Beep beep! So fun!"
"Let's trade!" Bubu handed the fan to Feifei, and Feifei gave the game console to Bubu. Best friends share everything!

pages.text:
放学了，咘咘抱着礼物跑出幼儿园，一眼就看到了外公外婆。
「外公！外婆！今天太好玩啦！有怪兽和熊猫木偶剧！还坐了长长的火车吃饭！还有礼物！」
咘咘说个不停，把手摇风扇摇给外婆看，又把游戏机给外公看。
pages.text_en:
School was over. Bubu ran out of kindergarten with her gifts and spotted Grandpa and Grandma right away.
"Grandpa! Grandma! Today was SO fun! There was a monster and panda puppet show! We ate breakfast on a long train! And we got presents!"
Bubu couldn't stop talking, showing the fan to Grandma and the game console to Grandpa.

pages.text:
晚上，咘咘躺在床上，还在摇着小风扇。NOMI 靠在枕头旁边，NONO 站在床头柜上。
「今天是最快乐的一天！」咘咘打了个大大的哈欠。
NOMI 轻轻说：「六一儿童节快乐，咘咘。」
NONO 小声说：「叽……明年六一还会更好玩的。」
咘咘笑着闭上了眼睛，梦里还在开长长的火车。
pages.text_en:
That night, Bubu lay in bed, still cranking her little fan. NOMI leaned against the pillow beside her, and NONO stood on the nightstand.
"Today was the happiest day ever!" Bubu gave a big yawn.
NOMI said softly: "Happy Children's Day, Bubu."
NONO whispered: "Chirp... next Children's Day will be even more fun."
Bubu smiled and closed her eyes. In her dreams, she was still driving the long, long train.

pages.text:
六一儿童节快乐！
每个小朋友都是最棒的！🎉
pages.text_en:
Happy Children's Day!
Every child is the best! 🎉
